action_items: OPTIONAL: On /profile, the 'Login email' input has no explicit validation preview — bad format is only caught on submit as a red toast. Consider inline validation state.

OPTIONAL: The Profile form uses a shared `current_password` field even when the user only edits name/email (no password change intended). This is fine, but the UI could visually collapse the 'Change password' section behind a toggle to reduce accidental input.

OPTIONAL: /api/auth/update-profile does not require current_password when changing email — only when changing password. This is standard, but higher-security apps re-prompt for the current password on email change to prevent session-hijack privilege escalation. Consider adding.
OPTIONAL (pre-existing, from iter-7): server.py is now ~1447 lines; consider router split. TeamCreate should use EmailStr. base_url for /auth/forgot-password should be pinned server-side.

OPTIONAL: /api/auth/update-profile does not invalidate other outstanding JWTs when the password changes (same issue as change-password / team set-password — flagged in iter-6/7). A password_changed_at field + JWT iat check would close this.
critical_code_review_comments: update_profile returns User(**fresh).model_dump() but also spreads session_token — good pattern. However the response does NOT set a fresh access_token httpOnly cookie, so if a user rotates their password and only uses the cookie (not localStorage Bearer), the OLD cookie still authorises them until it naturally expires. Consider response.set_cookie('access_token', new_token, ...) mirroring the login endpoint.

UpdateProfileBody uses Optional[str] for all fields — a client posting {} passes validation and this endpoint becomes a no-op (200 with same data). Not a bug, but consider rejecting empty payloads with 400.

Profile.js sends `name` and `email` on every submit even when unchanged. Server correctly no-ops if new email == current, but this makes email uniqueness lookup run on every save. Minor; consider only sending changed fields.

Profile.js: mismatch/short password checks return early via toast BUT do not clear submitting=false via finally — currently OK because setSubmitting(true) happens AFTER the early return, but this is order-sensitive. Move the guards into a try/finally or guard before setSubmitting.
